grades.quote: TSO atomic read-modify-writes and x86 instructions using the LOCK prefix are fully ordered and can be implemented either via an AMO with both _aq_ and _rl_ set, or via an LR with _aq_ set, the arithmetic operation in question, an SC with both _aq_ and _rl_ set, and a conditional branch checking the success condition.

grades.quote: The atomic-instruction extension, named "A", contains instructions that atomically read-modify-write memory to support synchronization between multiple RISC-V harts running in the same memory space. The two forms of atomic instruction provided are load-reserved/store-conditional instructions and atomic fetch-and-op memory instructions.
grades.reason: Explicitly identifies load-reserved/store-conditional as RISC-V's synchronization mechanism corresponding to the exclusive-load/store pattern.
